newsitem.title: PERU: Peru shares close down slightly in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Peru shares close down slightly in quiet trade.

text.p: Lima shares edged down slightly overall Monday on investor caution ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's announcement on interest rates Wednesday, brokers said.
They predicted a similar trend in Tuesday's trade due to a lack of market-moving political and economic news within Peru.
According to preliminary figures, the bolsa's General Index fell 0.87 percent to 2,155.28 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index lost 0.88 percent to 3,102.90.
Manuel Torres, of Finvest brokerage, said the market was expecting the Federal Reserve to maintain current rates, which would be beneficial for local shares.
Added to that, Peru's long-term economic prospects remained sound despite the possible emergence later in the year of the damaging El Nio weather phenomenon, he said.
Among leading stocks, electricity generator Edegel lost 8.76 percent to 1.25 soles after an initial market perform rating from Santander Investment.
"For short-term small investors, market perform simply means sell," said a broker at T&J.
Benchmark Telefnica del Per slipped 1.41 percent to 6.97 soles.
Winners included utilities Edelnor and Luz del Sur, up 2.44 percent to 2.1 soles and 0.32 percent to 3.11 soles, respectively.
